question: If x + y = 36, then find (x - 27)³ + (y - 9)³.
solution:
Given:

x + y = 36

Formula used:

 a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² - ab + b2)

Calculation:

⇒ x + y = 36

⇒ x + y - 36 = 0 ................(1)

⇒ (x - 27) + (y - 9) = 0
